annotations.text:
Redrawn against the running app.

The first version of this canvas showed two home sections. The app renders sixteen, in three different list shapes, driven by what the Subsonic server returns and what is enabled in settings. So it was a design for a different app, and implementing it faithfully could never have matched.

Every section here is one that exists, under its real label, in its real order and its real shape.

Density is content, not design.

These artboards show two or three items per section because that reads well at this size. On a small library a section may hold one item, or be hidden entirely - most sectors disappear when their feed comes back empty, and several can be turned off in settings.

The design has to survive one item as well as twenty.

Search is drawn from what the screen really is: Material's SearchBar over three result lists.

It needed almost nothing new - the section headings already share the home and library heading style, and the result rows are the same rows those screens use. Only the field itself moved, in to the page gutter.

The podcast and radio tabs are not drawn separately: both are vertical row lists built from the same pieces, on the Patterns sheet.
